name: Maritime Oil Painting
description: Oil-painting look for covers and hero scenes — loose visible brushwork, a pale ivory tonal range left open as negative space, and sepia, ochre and gold weathered colour against deep shadow.
style_bible: Oil painting on primed canvas. Medium and surface: loose visible brushwork, oil laid in directional strokes that stay readable as paint, thin scumbled glazes in the open upper field and thicker impasto reserved for edges that catch the light, with fine craquelure and a warm varnish bloom over the whole surface. Edges and shapes: painterly and soft almost everywhere, larger forms held together by tone rather than outline, fine linear details suggested with a few dry-brushed hairlines rather than drawn thread by thread; where the scene gives a horizon, it is slightly broken and never ruler-straight. Palette: sepia, ochre, raw and burnt sienna, aged gold and warm ivory through the lit passages, moving to deep navy, slate green and cold grey in the shadow, with oxblood and a single muted vermilion reserved for the smallest accents. Lighting: soft diffused light entering from one side and broken rather than striking hard; luminous open passages, no hard modern key light, no rim light, no artificial glow. Texture: canvas tooth visible through thin passages, dry-brush drag on fine linear forms, granular particles, and broken edges with light behind them. Subject grammar: one clear focal subject held against a wide open upper field, with the scene's own horizon kept low where it has one. Any figure the scene supplies is painted with the same loose handling and is never given an invented likeness. Framing: hold the upper third to two-fifths open and largely empty as deliberate negative space, left to the scene's own tone; place the subject low and to one side on a clear diagonal, keep any horizon below centre, and let atmosphere rather than detail carry the distance. Keep the contract content-independent: no fixed subject, place, era detail, event, or copied composition.
negative_prompt: photograph, photorealistic render, digital smoothness, airbrushed gradients, 3D render, CGI, vector art, flat cartoon, anime, neon, saturated modern colours, hard modern studio lighting, lens flare, bokeh, motion blur, cluttered text, readable lettering, captions, logos, watermarks, signatures, frames, borders, UI elements, copied reference composition
